## Use this when

- install an AI capability
- add an agent tool to my system
- deploy an AI workflow
- version and verify an AI capability
- add a safe AI tool

## Problem

Organizations adding AI capabilities need versioning, installation verification, runtime assignment, rollback and proof the capability actually works.

## Inputs

Authorized target environment, desired bounded capability, integration constraints and security/authority requirements.

## Outputs

Versioned capability artifacts, execution contract, install verification receipt, health check and rollback path.

## Pricing

Current hypothesis $500-$5,000 depending on environment/integration depth; not auto-quotable yet.

## Invocation and authority

Discoverable capability; environment-specific deployment/payment verification required.

Target-environment access, deployment and payment require explicit authorized approval. Discovery grants no deployment authority.

Payment authority: Evercraft Payments

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
